veranderings.rede: The idiom for being on opposing sides is 'teenoor mekaar staan'; 'teen mekaar staan' can read as physically leaning against each other.

vlae.teks: 'n stelsel van rasseskeiding waarin mense volgens hul ras behandel is
vlae.rede: Slightly vague: 'volgens hul ras behandel' does not say the treatment was different or unequal (the glossary says 'ongelyk behandel'); adding a qualifier would add content, so it is left for the writer to judge.
